name: Alien Egg
summary: At Freewind Post, Hagar Lightninghoof sends you after an egg guarded by serpents beneath the stone needles. He wants it brought back before anything inside can break free.

sections.title: A Strange Nest
sections.body: Hagar Lightninghoof hears of an unusual egg in the serpent dens below the stone needles. The canyon serpents guard it as though it were their own brood, striking at travelers who draw near. Concerned for the hunting grounds, Hagar asks you to find the nest, pass its sentries, and bring the strange egg back for study.

sections.title: The Hatchling Awakens
sections.body: When Hagar Lightninghoof examines the egg, its shell cracks at once. A Young Arikara, a juvenile winged monstrosity, bursts out. The newborn does not attack. It takes to the sky and flees from Freewind Post's wooden platforms, while deeper primordial forces stir in the canyon winds.

faq.q: Where can the Alien Egg be found?
faq.answer: The egg lies in serpent nests along the cliff bases of Thousand Needles, especially south and northeast of Freewind Post. It rests on the canyon floor among hostile native serpents.

faq.q: Why are the local serpents guarding it?
aliases: why do serpents protect the egg
faq.answer: No one knows what laid the egg, but the canyon serpents guard it as though it belonged to their own clutch. They attack curious intruders who approach the nest.

Hagar Lightninghoof is a tauren scout and warden stationed high above Thousand Needles at Freewind Post. He watches for unusual movement and threats to the canyon's wildlife, and coordinates Horde efforts to manage local beasts.

faq.q: What happens when you deliver the egg?
faq.answer: When you hand over the egg, Hagar examines it up close, revealing what it holds.

faq.q: What does this quest lead to?
faq.answer: Delivering the egg immediately begins Serpent Wild, the first step in a longer chain. Hagar seeks to understand what the egg held.

faq.q: Is the egg literally from outer space?
faq.answer: Here, “alien” means foreign and unfamiliar to Thousand Needles' local wildlife, not a creature from the stars. Hagar wants to learn what kind of creature the egg holds.

angles.text: As a tauren, you live above the canyon floor at Freewind Post and depend on understanding the wildlife below. An invasive or unnatural serpent brood could disrupt the balance around your home.
As a hunter familiar with Kalimdor's beasts, you may recognize that the nests in the canyon hold something far more primordial than common desert serpents.
As a member of the Horde, you know Freewind Post is your main outpost in Thousand Needles. Containing emerging apex predators helps defend the supply lines.
